#!/bin/zsh
query="$1"
# If no query, show all apps. If query exists, filter strictly if [[ -z "$query" || "$query" == "" ]]; then # Show all apps apps_to_show=$(find /Applications -maxdepth 2 -name "*.app" -type d 2>/dev/null | sort) else # Filter apps by query query_lower=$(echo "$query" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') apps_to_show=$(find /Applications -maxdepth 2 -name "*.app" -type d 2>/dev/null | while read app; do app_name=$(basename "$app" .app) app_lower=$(echo "$app_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') [[ "$app_lower" == *"$query_lower"* ]] && echo "$app" done | sort) fi
# Start JSON echo '{"items": ['
first=true count=0
# Process filtered apps echo "$apps_to_show" | while IFS= read -r app_path; do [[ -z "$app_path" ]] && continue
app_name=$(basename "$app_path" .app)
# Get bundle ID bundle_id="" if [[ -f "$app_path/Contents/Info.plist" ]]; then bundle_id=$(defaults read "$app_path/Contents/Info.plist" CFBundleIdentifier 2>/dev/null || echo "") fi
# Check if running running_status="" pids=$(pgrep -f "$app_name" 2>/dev/null | xargs) is_running=false if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then is_running=true running_status=" •" fi
# JSON comma handling [[ "$first" == "true" ]] && first=false || echo ","
# Escape for JSON app_name_esc=$(printf '%s' "$app_name" | sed 's/["\\]/\\&/g') app_path_esc=$(printf '%s' "$app_path" | sed 's/["\\]/\\&/g') bundle_id_esc=$(printf '%s' "$bundle_id" | sed 's/["\\]/\\&/g')
cat << EOF { "title": "$app_name_esc$running_status", "subtitle": "$app_path_esc", "arg": "open|||$app_name_esc|||$bundle_id_esc|||$app_path_esc|||$pids", "mods": { "cmd": { "arg": "quit|||$app_name_esc|||$bundle_id_esc|||$app_path_esc|||$pids", "subtitle": "Quit $app_name_esc", "valid": $is_running }, "cmd+shift": { "arg": "restart|||$app_name_esc|||$bundle_id_esc|||$app_path_esc|||$pids", "subtitle": "Restart $app_name_esc", "valid": $is_running } }, "icon": {"path": "$app_path_esc", "type": "fileicon"} } EOF
count=$((count + 1)) [[ $count -ge 50 ]] && break
done
echo ']}'
